_comment: Coordinate-free source of build/submission/spec.json. Each allele is a selector that must match exactly one row of a warehouse result table; tools/resolve_submission_spec.py resolves it to (chrom, pos, ref, alt) on a machine with database access and writes the gitignored spec. Rows and hypotheses are copied through unchanged.

rows.label: stop+missense
rows.notes: H:H009 | BUB1B | compound heterozygote: ClinVar-pathogenic stop_gained (VCV000533901, MVA syndrome 1) + gnomAD-absent missense in the C-terminal kinase domain (AlphaMissense likely pathogenic 0.92, CADD 24.5); both het PASS at 44x; phase unresolved by reads; genome-wide scan finds no competing biallelic gene; phenotype ranking places BUB1B 6th of 5,267

rows.label: stop+intronA
rows.notes: H:H009 alternative partner | BUB1B | stop_gained + gnomAD-absent intronic allele (SpliceAI 0.00); a full match here decodes the pairing directly

rows.label: missense+intronA
rows.notes: H:H009 alternative partner | BUB1B | missense + gnomAD-absent intronic allele

rows.label: stop+intronB
rows.notes: H:H009 alternative partner | BUB1B | stop_gained + rare intronic allele (gnomAD 0.002, ClinVar VUS, SpliceAI 0.00)

rows.label: missense+intronB
rows.notes: H:H009 alternative partner | BUB1B | missense + rare intronic allele

rows.label: LZTR1 stop_gained (secondary)
rows.notes: secondary | LZTR1 | heterozygous stop_gained, ClinVar pathogenic/likely pathogenic, gnomAD 1.4e-6; dominant schwannomatosis predisposition (unrelated to MVA); reported for clinical follow-up, not scored

rows.label: F5 Leiden (secondary)
rows.notes: secondary | F5 | heterozygous Factor V Leiden (rs6025), ClinVar pathogenic low-penetrance risk factor for venous thrombosis; common carrier state, relevant to peri-operative and oncology care

rows.label: FLG stop_gained (secondary)
rows.notes: secondary | FLG | heterozygous stop_gained, ClinVar pathogenic, gnomAD 0.003; semi-dominant ichthyosis vulgaris / atopy risk allele; low clinical priority
